# `body_plan`

The parts a body starts with and how they are joined (06 §6.2).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `height` ([length](../units.md#length) in `m`; optional): How tall a body of this plan stands at scale 1.
- `footprint` (list of 3: whole number, 0 or more, whole number, 0 or more, whole number, 0 or more, or `null`; optional): The cells a body of this plan fills, along x, y and storeys. Default one cell.
- `parts` (list of object [`PlanPartDef`](#planpartdef); **required**): The parts. Exactly one is the root, attached to nothing.
- `needs` (object, id of a [`body_function`](body_function.md) → one of `"unconscious"`, `"dead"` ([`Stop`](#stop)); optional): The functions a body of this plan cannot do without, and what having none of one does to an owner that has a mind (06 §8.3): `unconscious` or `dead`.

<a id="planpartdef"></a>
### `PlanPartDef`

One part of a plan (06 §6.2).

- `id` (string; **required**): The part's name within a body of this plan.
- `part` (id of a [`body_part`](body_part.md); **required**): What it is.
- `on` (string, or `null`; optional): The part it is attached to from outside: lose that and this goes too.
- `in` (string, or `null`; optional): The part it sits inside: it is reached only through that part's layers.
- `socket` (string, or `null`; optional): The socket of the part it is `on` that it takes.
- `side` (string, or `null`; optional): A label telling this part from its twin: `"left"`. Free text.
- `scale` (number; optional): Its size relative to the rest of the body. Default 1.

<a id="stop"></a>
### `Stop`

What a definition says a lack does to a creature with a mind (06 §8.3). The later is the worse.

One of:

- `"unconscious"`: Its mind stops driving it until the lack is gone.
- `"dead"`: Its mind stops driving it for good.
